"Create a mobile web game called \"ADA Super League - Basketball\" inspired by Super League football game, but for basketball, for kids aged 8-15, for ADA BASKETBALL ACADEMY.

Core Gameplay:
Arcade basketball league game, 5 vs 5, top-down / side view. Player controls one team. Match duration 2 minutes. Controls: 1 joystick to move, 3 big buttons: PASS, SHOOT, STEAL / BLOCK. Swipe up to shoot, swipe left/right to pass. Very easy controls for kids on mobile.

League Mode:
Player starts in Bronze League, must win matches to climb to Silver, Gold, Platinum, and ADA Champion League. Each league has 4 teams with funny names: e.g. Rookie Rockets, Dunk Dragons, Mini Lakers, Street Sharks. Win = 3 points, get coins and XP. Lose = can retry.

Team Building:
Player starts with 5 cartoon kid players. Each player has stats: Speed, Shoot, Dribble, Defense. Player can upgrade players with coins, unlock new jerseys (ADA Orange Jersey), unlock new courts (School Court, Park Court, ADA Arena).

Visual Style:
Bright cartoon 2D, like Super League but basketball. Orange and navy color theme. Big characters, big ball, clear court lines. Fun sound effects: bounce, swish, crowd cheer. Background music upbeat.

ADA Branding @COMMENT_BODY@ Lead Generation (VERY IMPORTANT):
1. Start screen: Logo \"ADA BASKETBALL ACADEMY - SUPER LEAGUE\". Input form: Kid Name, Age, School, Parent WhatsApp Number. Player must fill this to save progress and enter leaderboard.
2. Leaderboard: Global, Per School, Per Age Group (8-11 and 12-15).
3. After winning a League, show popup: \"KAMU JUARA! Kamu naik ke [Next League]! Kamu dapat 1x FREE TRIAL di ADA Basketball Academy. Klaim Hadiahmu!\" with WhatsApp button.
4. Share button on every win screen: \"Pamerin Piala Kamu! Tantang Temanmu!\" - share score + link via WhatsApp.
5. Daily Reward: Login every day to get free coins and 1 card pack.

Language: All UI text in Bahasa Indonesia, simple words for kids.
Platform: Mobile-first, portrait mode, playable in browser, no download.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}

```
function shotChance(shooter, dist, defenderClose) {
 const s = shooter.stats.shoot;
 let base = 0.9 - Math.max(0, dist-40)*0.0019; // dist 40 => .9, 300 => .406, 450 => .12
 base = clamp(base, 0.12, 0.94);
 base += (s-60)*0.004; // shoot 80 => +.08
 if (defenderClose) base -= 0.18;
 if (isDunk) base = 0.92;
 return clamp(base, 0.08, 0.96);
}
```

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile-first browser game "ADA Super League - Basketball" for ADA Basketball Academy: 5v5 arcade basketball, 5 leagues, team upgrades, leaderboard, daily rewards, and WhatsApp lead-generation flows.
- All UI text in simple Bahasa Indonesia, portrait mode, bright cartoon orange/navy style.

## Requirements
- Match duration 2 minutes; 5v5; joystick + 3 buttons PASS, SHOOT, STEAL/BLOCK; swipe up to shoot, left/right to pass.
- Leagues: Bronze → Silver → Gold → Platinum → ADA Champion, 4 teams each with funny names; win = 3 points, coins, XP; lose can retry.
- Team: 5 kid players with Speed/Shoot/Dribble/Defense; upgrade with coins; unlock ADA Orange Jersey, courts (School Court, Park Court, ADA Arena).

## ADA Super League — Basketball

A mobile-first, 5v5 arcade basketball game for ADA Basketball Academy. Everything runs in the browser with plain HTML, CSS, and ES modules — no build step, no external art or audio files.

### Play

```bash
./start.sh
# open http://localhost:3000
```

The game is designed for portrait phones (390 × 844 is the reference viewport), but it also scales to desktop.

### Features

- 2-minute 5v5 matches with joystick movement and PASS / SHOOT / STEAL buttons. Swipe up on the court to shoot, swipe left/right to pass.
- Five leagues (Bronze → Silver → Gold → Platinum → ADA Champion), four funny teams per league, and friendly rematches.
- Player upgrades (Speed, Shoot, Dribble, Defense), jerseys, and courts bought with coins.
- Local leaderboard with Global, School, and Age Group (8–11 / 12–15) tabs.
- Daily reward (coins + card pack) and a card-pack shop with duplicates converted to coins.
- Champion flow with a 1× free-trial WhatsApp claim, plus a “Pamerin Piala Kamu!” share button after every win.
- Progress is stored in `localStorage` under `ada_super_league_v1`.

### Configuration

- Academy WhatsApp number: `ACADEMY_WA` in `js/data.js`. The checked-in value (`6281234567890`) is a demo placeholder — replace it with the real academy number before launch.
- All artwork is drawn with Canvas, CSS, or inline SVG. All sound effects and music are synthesized with WebAudio.

### Project layout

```
index.html        app shell and screens
css/style.css     cartoon mobile UI
js/main.js        entry point
js/ui.js          screens, modals, match flow, rewards
js/state.js       localStorage state, progression, leaderboard
js/data.js        leagues, teams, jerseys, courts, card pool
js/game.js        canvas 5v5 engine, AI, physics, rendering
js/audio.js       synthesized SFX and music
screenshots/      verification screenshots (JPEG)
```
